label: GO step, choosing a1 after an unrewarded trial (mid-episode)
explanation: Fires only at GO (never D1/D2), almost only when the agent picks a1 (98% of mass; model_act==1 99%) with a strongly a1-favoring policy logit (64% of mass in the top choice bin), and mostly when the previous trial was unrewarded (93% of mass). It is gated by episode position: almost silent in trials 0-29 and 80-99, peaking at trials 40-69. The predicate GO & prev_reward==0 & action==1 covers 91% of activation mass and nearly all of the top two quartiles, but precision is low (~0.12): the unit fires on only a minority of matching steps, and adding an ep_trial 30-80 window raises precision only to ~0.18. Steps it misses (GO after a rewarded trial, choosing a1) carry tiny activations. action at GO is the upcoming choice of the agent itself, which it computes, so the predicate uses no unobservable outcome. It does not fire on a2 choices, rewarded-input steps, or any D1/D2 step. Magnitude is largest with prev_reward==0 and a1 chosen; it is not clearly modulated by the transition or by core pattern.
